The data can't settle the direction, so I'm going on physical reasoning. Residual_GH_mean and Residual_longwave correlate at about 0.27, so some link exists. Geopotential height reflects large-scale atmospheric circulation. That circulation shapes cloud and moisture conditions, which in turn set the downward longwave flux at the surface. Longwave flux is unlikely to drive the large-scale height field. A fits better than B, C or D.

ANSWER: A
